changelog:
Initial release with automated Jable video downloads and real-time progress monitoring:

- Supports downloading individual videos or searching and batch downloading by actress name from Jable.tv.
- Automatically starts a local Flask web server to show real-time download progress.
- Sends a Telegram notification with the progress page link when a download starts.
- Organizes downloaded videos into folders named after the actress.
- Provides a modern, responsive progress web page with live status, speed, ETA, and file info.
- Checks and ensures all required dependencies (yt-dlp, ffmpeg, python3, flask) are installed before running.
summary: Download videos from Jable.tv. Triggered when the user mentions "download Jable video", "jable download", or uses /skill jable.
